# Tidewater Jobs

> Tidewater Jobs is a hosted scheduler for data jobs: a cron replacement with retries, secrets and an HTTP API.

Documentation pages are also available as Markdown: add `.md` to the page URL, for example https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/quick-start.md.

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/quick-start.md): install and run a first job
- [Installation](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/install.md): how to install Tidewater Jobs
- [Job file reference](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/job-file.md): fields of a job file
- [Scheduling syntax](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/schedules.md): how schedules are written
- [Retries and timeouts](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/retries.md): retry and timeout behaviour
- [Secrets](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/secrets.md): storing and using secrets in jobs
- [HTTP API overview](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/api.md): the HTTP API
- [API: jobs](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/api/jobs.md): job endpoints
- [API: runs](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/api/runs.md): run endpoints
- [API: webhooks](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/api/webhooks.md): webhook endpoints
- [CLI reference](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/cli.md): command-line commands and options
- [Self-hosting](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/self-hosting.md): running the scheduler on your own servers
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/troubleshooting.md): common problems and fixes
- [Migrating from 1.x](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/migrate-1x.md): moving jobs from version 1.x
- [Glossary](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/glossary.md): terms used in the product
- [FAQ](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/faq.md): frequently asked questions
- [Python SDK](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/sdk/python.md): the Python client library
- [Node SDK](https://www.tidewater-jobs.example/docs/sdk/node.md): the Node client library
